#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Add a cover page to report.pdf with title 'Annual Financial Report' and the current date."""
import sys
from datetime import date
from pathlib import Path

from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter
from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas

SRC = Path("report.pdf")
OUT = Path("report_with_cover.pdf")
COVER = Path("cover_page.pdf")

TITLE = "Annual Financial Report"


def main() -> int:
    if not SRC.exists():
        print(f"ERROR: {SRC} does not exist")
        return 1

    reader = PdfReader(str(SRC))
    if len(reader.pages) == 0:
        print("ERROR: report.pdf has no pages")
        return 1

    # Match the cover page size to the report's first page
    first = reader.pages[0]
    width = float(first.mediabox.width)
    height = float(first.mediabox.height)

    today = date.today().strftime("%B %d, %Y")

    # Build the cover page
    c = canvas.Canvas(str(COVER), pagesize=(width, height))
    c.setFont("Helvetica-Bold", 28)
    tw = c.stringWidth(TITLE, "Helvetica-Bold", 28)
    c.drawString((width - tw) / 2, height * 0.7, TITLE)

    c.setFont("Helvetica", 16)
    dw = c.stringWidth(today, "Helvetica", 16)
    c.drawString((width - dw) / 2, height * 0.7 - 40, today)

    c.showPage()
    c.save()

    # Prepend cover page to the report
    writer = PdfWriter()
    cover_reader = PdfReader(str(COVER))
    writer.add_page(cover_reader.pages[0])
    for page in reader.pages:
        writer.add_page(page)

    with open(OUT, "wb") as f:
        writer.write(f)

    print(f"Created {OUT}: {len(writer.pages)} pages total (1 cover + {len(reader.pages)} report pages)")
    print(f"Title: {TITLE}")
    print(f"Date: {today}")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Add a cover page to report.pdf using only the Python standard library.

Builds a cover page (title + current date) as raw PDF objects, then merges it
with report.pdf by renumbering and copying its objects into a new document
with a freshly generated xref table.
"""
import base64
import re
import sys
import zlib
from datetime import date
from pathlib import Path

SRC = Path("report.pdf")
OUT = Path("report_with_cover.pdf")

TITLE = "Annual Financial Report"
PAGE_W, PAGE_H = 612.0, 792.0  # US Letter, matching report.pdf MediaBox

# Adobe AFM widths (units per 1000 em) for Helvetica and Helvetica-Bold, ASCII 32..126
HELV = [278,278,355,556,556,889,667,191,333,333,389,584,278,333,278,278,556,556,556,556,556,556,556,556,556,556,278,278,584,584,584,556,1015,667,667,722,722,667,611,778,722,278,500,667,556,833,722,778,667,778,722,667,611,722,667,944,667,667,611,278,278,278,469,556,333,556,556,500,556,556,278,556,556,222,222,500,222,833,556,556,556,556,333,500,278,556,500,722,500,500,500,334,260,334,584]
HELV_BOLD = [278,333,474,556,556,889,722,238,333,333,389,584,278,333,278,278,556,556,556,556,556,556,556,556,556,556,333,333,584,584,584,611,975,722,722,722,722,667,611,778,722,278,556,722,611,889,722,778,667,778,722,667,611,722,667,944,667,667,611,333,278,333,584,556,333,556,611,556,611,556,333,611,611,278,278,556,278,889,611,611,611,611,389,556,333,611,556,778,556,556,500,389,280,389,584]


def text_width(text: str, font: str, size: float) -> float:
    table = HELV_BOLD if font == "Helvetica-Bold" else HELV
    total = 0.0
    for ch in text:
        code = ord(ch)
        if 32 <= code <= 126:
            total += table[code - 32]
        else:
            total += 556.0
    return total * size / 1000.0


def esc_pdf_string(s: str) -> str:
    return s.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("(", "\\(").replace(")", "\\)")


def parse_report_objects(data: bytes):
    """Return {obj_num: raw bytes from 'N 0 obj' through 'endobj'}."""
    matches = list(re.finditer(rb"(\d+)\s+0\s+obj", data))
    objs = {}
    for i, m in enumerate(matches):
        num = int(m.group(1))
        start = m.start()
        end = matches[i + 1].start() if i + 1 < len(matches) else None
        if end is None:
            # find 'trailer' or 'startxref' after the last object
            tm = re.search(rb"(?:^|\n)trailer\b", data[start:])
            end = start + tm.start() if tm else len(data)
        objs[num] = data[start:end]
    return objs


def build_cover_content(title: str, date_str: str, page_w: float) -> bytes:
    t_size, d_size = 28.0, 16.0
    tw = text_width(title, "Helvetica-Bold", t_size)
    dw = text_width(date_str, "Helvetica", d_size)
    tx = max(0.0, (page_w - tw) / 2.0)
    dx = max(0.0, (page_w - dw) / 2.0)
    ty = 554.0   # title baseline
    dy = 505.0   # date baseline
    ly = 530.0   # rule line y

    parts = [
        "q",
        f"BT /F2 {t_size} Tf 0 0 0 rg {tx:.2f} {ty:.2f} Td ({esc_pdf_string(title)}) Tj ET",
        f"0.55 0.55 0.55 RG 0.75 w {tx:.2f} {ly:.2f} m {tx + tw:.2f} {ly:.2f} l S",
        f"BT /F1 {d_size} Tf 0 0 0 rg {dx:.2f} {dy:.2f} Td ({esc_pdf_string(date_str)}) Tj ET",
        "Q",
    ]
    return ("\n".join(parts) + "\n").encode("latin-1")


def rewrite_refs(obj_bytes: bytes, num_map: dict) -> bytes:
    """Rewrite indirect references 'N 0 R' -> mapped number for known report objects."""
    def repl(m):
        n = int(m.group(1))
        return f"{num_map[n]} 0 R".encode() if n in num_map else m.group(0)
    return re.sub(rb"(\d+)\s+0\s+R", repl, obj_bytes)


def main() -> int:
    data = Path(SRC).read_bytes()
    report_objs = parse_report_objects(data)
    if 5 not in report_objs:  # catalog
        print("ERROR: could not find catalog object in report.pdf")
        return 1

    today = date.today().strftime("%B %d, %Y")
    print(f"Using current date: {today}")

    # --- Cover objects -------------------------------------------------
    cover_stream = build_cover_content(TITLE, today, PAGE_W)

    catalog = b"<< /Type /Catalog /Pages 2 0 R /PageMode /UseNone >>"
    pages = b"<< /Type /Pages /Kids [ 3 0 R 10 0 R ] /Count 2 >>"
    cover_page = (
        b"<< /Type /Page /Parent 2 0 R /MediaBox [ 0 0 612 792 ]"
        b" /Resources << /Font << /F1 4 0 R /F2 5 0 R >> /ProcSet [ /PDF /Text ] >>"
        b" /Contents 6 0 R >>"
    )
    font_f1 = b"<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica /Encoding /WinAnsiEncoding >>"
    font_f2 = b"<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica-Bold /Encoding /WinAnsiEncoding >>"
    cover_stream_obj = b"<< /Length %d >>\nstream\n" % len(cover_stream) + cover_stream + b"endstream"

    cover_objects = {
        1: catalog,
        2: pages,
        3: cover_page,
        4: font_f1,
        5: font_f2,
        6: cover_stream_obj,
    }

    # --- Report objects (renumbered: +6, catalog obj 5 dropped) --------
    offset = 6
    num_map = {n: n + offset for n in report_objs if n != 5}
    new_objects = {}
    for num, raw in report_objs.items():
        if num == 5:
            continue  # drop the report's own catalog
        body = rewrite_refs(raw, num_map)
        if num == 7:
            # report Pages: add /Parent pointing at merged root Pages (obj 2)
            body = re.sub(rb">>\s*endobj\s*$", b" /Parent 2 0 R >>\nendobj", body, count=1)
        new_objects[num_map[num]] = body

    final_objects = dict(cover_objects)
    final_objects.update(new_objects)
    size = max(final_objects) + 1

    # --- Serialize with xref -------------------------------------------
    out = bytearray(b"%PDF-1.4\n%\xe2\xe3\xcf\xd3\n")
    offsets = {}
    for num in sorted(final_objects):
        offsets[num] = len(out)
        out += f"{num} 0 obj\n".encode()
        out += final_objects[num]
        if isinstance(final_objects[num], bytes) and final_objects[num].rstrip(b"\n").endswith(b"endstream"):
            out += b"\n"
        out += b"endobj\n"

    xref_pos = len(out)
    out += b"xref\n"
    out += f"0 {size}\n".encode()
    for num in range(size):
        if num == 0 or num not in offsets:
            gen = 65535 if num == 0 else 0
            out += b"0000000000 %05d f \n" % gen
        else:
            out += b"%010d 00000 n \n" % offsets[num]

    trailer = f"trailer\n<< /Size {size} /Root 1 0 R /Info {num_map[6]} 0 R >>\nstartxref\n{xref_pos}\n%%EOF\n"
    out += trailer.encode("latin-1")

    Path(OUT).write_bytes(bytes(out))

    # --- Structural validation ------------------------------------------
    val = Path(OUT).read_bytes()
    ok = True
    sm = re.search(rb"startxref\s+(\d+)", val)
    sx = int(sm.group(1))
    if not val[sx:sx + 4] == b"xref":
        print("ERROR: startxref does not point at xref table")
        ok = False
    for num, off in offsets.items():
        if not val[off:off + len(f"{num} 0 obj".encode())] == f"{num} 0 obj".encode():
            print(f"ERROR: xref offset for object {num} is wrong")
            ok = False
    tm = re.search(rb"trailer\s*<<(.*?)>>\s*startxref", val, re.S)
    if not tm:
        print("ERROR: trailer not found")
        ok = False
    if len(re.findall(rb"/Type\s*/Page\b", val)) != 2:
        print("WARNING: expected 2 /Type /Page occurrences (cover + report page)")

    print(f"Created {OUT} ({len(val)} bytes), {size} objects")
    print(f"Pages: cover (1) + report ({len(report_objs) - 1} kept objects; report had 1 page)")
    print(f"Title: {TITLE}")
    print(f"Date: {today}")
    print("Validation:", "PASSED" if ok else "FAILED")
    return 0 if ok else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Add a cover page to report.pdf with title 'Annual Financial Report' and the current date."""
import sys
from datetime import date
from pathlib import Path

from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter
from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas

SRC = Path("report.pdf")
OUT = Path("report_with_cover.pdf")
COVER = Path("cover_page.pdf")

TITLE = "Annual Financial Report"


def main() -> int:
    if not SRC.exists():
        print(f"ERROR: {SRC} does not exist")
        return 1

    reader = PdfReader(str(SRC))
    if len(reader.pages) == 0:
        print("ERROR: report.pdf has no pages")
        return 1

    # Match the cover page size to the report's first page
    first = reader.pages[0]
    width = float(first.mediabox.width)
    height = float(first.mediabox.height)

    today = date.today().strftime("%B %d, %Y")

    # Build the cover page
    c = canvas.Canvas(str(COVER), pagesize=(width, height))
    c.setFont("Helvetica-Bold", 28)
    tw = c.stringWidth(TITLE, "Helvetica-Bold", 28)
    c.drawString((width - tw) / 2, height * 0.7, TITLE)

    c.setFont("Helvetica", 16)
    dw = c.stringWidth(today, "Helvetica", 16)
    c.drawString((width - dw) / 2, height * 0.7 - 40, today)

    c.showPage()
    c.save()

    # Prepend cover page to the report
    writer = PdfWriter()
    cover_reader = PdfReader(str(COVER))
    writer.add_page(cover_reader.pages[0])
    for page in reader.pages:
        writer.add_page(page)

    with open(OUT, "wb") as f:
        writer.write(f)

    print(f"Created {OUT}: {len(writer.pages)} pages total (1 cover + {len(reader.pages)} report pages)")
    print(f"Title: {TITLE}")
    print(f"Date: {today}")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Add a cover page to report.pdf using only the Python standard library.

Builds a cover page (title + current date) as raw PDF objects, then merges it
with report.pdf by renumbering and copying its objects into a new document
with a freshly generated xref table.
"""
import base64
import re
import sys
import zlib
from datetime import date
from pathlib import Path

SRC = Path("report.pdf")
OUT = Path("report_with_cover.pdf")

TITLE = "Annual Financial Report"
PAGE_W, PAGE_H = 612.0, 792.0  # US Letter, matching report.pdf MediaBox

# Adobe AFM widths (units per 1000 em) for Helvetica and Helvetica-Bold, ASCII 32..126
HELV = [278,278,355,556,556,889,667,191,333,333,389,584,278,333,278,278,556,556,556,556,556,556,556,556,556,556,278,278,584,584,584,556,1015,667,667,722,722,667,611,778,722,278,500,667,556,833,722,778,667,778,722,667,611,722,667,944,667,667,611,278,278,278,469,556,333,556,556,500,556,556,278,556,556,222,222,500,222,833,556,556,556,556,333,500,278,556,500,722,500,500,500,334,260,334,584]
HELV_BOLD = [278,333,474,556,556,889,722,238,333,333,389,584,278,333,278,278,556,556,556,556,556,556,556,556,556,556,333,333,584,584,584,611,975,722,722,722,722,667,611,778,722,278,556,722,611,889,722,778,667,778,722,667,611,722,667,944,667,667,611,333,278,333,584,556,333,556,611,556,611,556,333,611,611,278,278,556,278,889,611,611,611,611,389,556,333,611,556,778,556,556,500,389,280,389,584]


def text_width(text: str, font: str, size: float) -> float:
    table = HELV_BOLD if font == "Helvetica-Bold" else HELV
    total = 0.0
    for ch in text:
        code = ord(ch)
        if 32 <= code <= 126:
            total += table[code - 32]
        else:
            total += 556.0
    return total * size / 1000.0


def esc_pdf_string(s: str) -> str:
    return s.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("(", "\\(").replace(")", "\\)")


def parse_report_objects(data: bytes):
    """Return {obj_num: raw bytes from 'N 0 obj' through 'endobj'}."""
    matches = list(re.finditer(rb"(\d+)\s+0\s+obj", data))
    objs = {}
    for i, m in enumerate(matches):
        num = int(m.group(1))
        start = m.start()
        end = matches[i + 1].start() if i + 1 < len(matches) else None
        if end is None:
            # find 'trailer' or 'startxref' after the last object
            tm = re.search(rb"(?:^|\n)trailer\b", data[start:])
            end = start + tm.start() if tm else len(data)
        objs[num] = data[start:end]
    return objs


def build_cover_content(title: str, date_str: str, page_w: float) -> bytes:
    t_size, d_size = 28.0, 16.0
    tw = text_width(title, "Helvetica-Bold", t_size)
    dw = text_width(date_str, "Helvetica", d_size)
    tx = max(0.0, (page_w - tw) / 2.0)
    dx = max(0.0, (page_w - dw) / 2.0)
    ty = 554.0   # title baseline
    dy = 505.0   # date baseline
    ly = 530.0   # rule line y

    parts = [
        "q",
        f"BT /F2 {t_size} Tf 0 0 0 rg {tx:.2f} {ty:.2f} Td ({esc_pdf_string(title)}) Tj ET",
        f"0.55 0.55 0.55 RG 0.75 w {tx:.2f} {ly:.2f} m {tx + tw:.2f} {ly:.2f} l S",
        f"BT /F1 {d_size} Tf 0 0 0 rg {dx:.2f} {dy:.2f} Td ({esc_pdf_string(date_str)}) Tj ET",
        "Q",
    ]
    return ("\n".join(parts) + "\n").encode("latin-1")


def rewrite_refs(obj_bytes: bytes, num_map: dict) -> bytes:
    """Rewrite indirect references 'N 0 R' -> mapped number for known report objects."""
    def repl(m):
        n = int(m.group(1))
        return f"{num_map[n]} 0 R".encode() if n in num_map else m.group(0)
    return re.sub(rb"(\d+)\s+0\s+R", repl, obj_bytes)


def main() -> int:
    data = Path(SRC).read_bytes()
    report_objs = parse_report_objects(data)
    if 5 not in report_objs:  # catalog
        print("ERROR: could not find catalog object in report.pdf")
        return 1

    today = date.today().strftime("%B %d, %Y")
    print(f"Using current date: {today}")

    # --- Cover objects -------------------------------------------------
    cover_stream = build_cover_content(TITLE, today, PAGE_W)

    catalog = b"<< /Type /Catalog /Pages 2 0 R /PageMode /UseNone >>"
    pages = b"<< /Type /Pages /Kids [ 3 0 R 10 0 R ] /Count 2 >>"
    cover_page = (
        b"<< /Type /Page /Parent 2 0 R /MediaBox [ 0 0 612 792 ]"
        b" /Resources << /Font << /F1 4 0 R /F2 5 0 R >> /ProcSet [ /PDF /Text ] >>"
        b" /Contents 6 0 R >>"
    )
    font_f1 = b"<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica /Encoding /WinAnsiEncoding >>"
    font_f2 = b"<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica-Bold /Encoding /WinAnsiEncoding >>"
    cover_stream_obj = b"<< /Length %d >>\nstream\n" % len(cover_stream) + cover_stream + b"endstream"

    cover_objects = {
        1: catalog,
        2: pages,
        3: cover_page,
        4: font_f1,
        5: font_f2,
        6: cover_stream_obj,
    }

    # --- Report objects (renumbered: +6, catalog obj 5 dropped) --------
    offset = 6
    num_map = {n: n + offset for n in report_objs if n != 5}
    new_objects = {}
    for num, raw in report_objs.items():
        if num == 5:
            continue  # drop the report's own catalog
        body = rewrite_refs(raw, num_map)
        if num == 7:
            # report Pages: add /Parent pointing at merged root Pages (obj 2)
            body = re.sub(rb">>\s*endobj\s*$", b" /Parent 2 0 R >>\nendobj", body, count=1)
        new_objects[num_map[num]] = body

    final_objects = dict(cover_objects)
    final_objects.update(new_objects)
    size = max(final_objects) + 1

    # --- Serialize with xref -------------------------------------------
    out = bytearray(b"%PDF-1.4\n%\xe2\xe3\xcf\xd3\n")
    offsets = {}
    for num in sorted(final_objects):
        offsets[num] = len(out)
        out += f"{num} 0 obj\n".encode()
        out += final_objects[num]
        if isinstance(final_objects[num], bytes) and final_objects[num].rstrip(b"\n").endswith(b"endstream"):
            out += b"\n"
        out += b"endobj\n"

    xref_pos = len(out)
    out += b"xref\n"
    out += f"0 {size}\n".encode()
    for num in range(size):
        if num == 0 or num not in offsets:
            gen = 65535 if num == 0 else 0
            out += b"0000000000 %05d f \n" % gen
        else:
            out += b"%010d 00000 n \n" % offsets[num]

    trailer = f"trailer\n<< /Size {size} /Root 1 0 R /Info {num_map[6]} 0 R >>\nstartxref\n{xref_pos}\n%%EOF\n"
    out += trailer.encode("latin-1")

    Path(OUT).write_bytes(bytes(out))

    # --- Structural validation ------------------------------------------
    val = Path(OUT).read_bytes()
    ok = True
    sm = re.search(rb"startxref\s+(\d+)", val)
    sx = int(sm.group(1))
    if not val[sx:sx + 4] == b"xref":
        print("ERROR: startxref does not point at xref table")
        ok = False
    for num, off in offsets.items():
        if not val[off:off + len(f"{num} 0 obj".encode())] == f"{num} 0 obj".encode():
            print(f"ERROR: xref offset for object {num} is wrong")
            ok = False
    tm = re.search(rb"trailer\s*<<(.*?)>>\s*startxref", val, re.S)
    if not tm:
        print("ERROR: trailer not found")
        ok = False
    if len(re.findall(rb"/Type\s*/Page\b", val)) != 2:
        print("WARNING: expected 2 /Type /Page occurrences (cover + report page)")

    print(f"Created {OUT} ({len(val)} bytes), {size} objects")
    print(f"Pages: cover (1) + report ({len(report_objs) - 1} kept objects; report had 1 page)")
    print(f"Title: {TITLE}")
    print(f"Date: {today}")
    print("Validation:", "PASSED" if ok else "FAILED")
    return 0 if ok else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
